'''''Emerald Lance''''' was a modified [[YV-330 light freighter]].<ref name="G2" />

Externally, the ''Emerald Lance'' looked like a typical YV-330 freighter, but it had been extensively refitted as a clandestine warship. The idea was that the ship would appear to be a tempting target for pirates, but when they tried to attack, it would ambush and destroy them with its hidden weaponry. <ref name="G2" />

The armament included two fire-linked, turret-mounted heavy laser cannon, four forward-firing [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] and an [[autoblaster]]. There was also a powerful [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] salvo concealed in the sides of the hull, comprising four fire-linked [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|launchers]] with three missiles each.<ref name="G2" />

Compared to a stock YV-330, the ''Emerald Lance'' also had faster engines, a more powerful deflector, and an enhanced sensor package. The new sensor array was the only externally obvious modification, as it was a standard upgrade package for the type.<ref name="G2" />

Alongside its concealed combat capability, the ''Emerald Lance'' also retained a reasonably large hold, as the ability to carry genuine cargo made it appear a more convincing and tempting target to watching pirates. However, the weight limit for the hold was just five metric tons, and the ship's cargo capacity was not large enough for it to function effectively as a legitimate freighter.<ref name="G2" />

Instead, the ship had once served with the [[Corellian Security Force]], although by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it had been sold to a group of freelance pirate hunters.<ref name="G2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Emerald Lance'' appears in [[Star Wars Gamer 2|''Star Wars Gamer'' 2]]. A twin-barrelled chin turret is visible in the illustration, but it is not explained how these guns relate to the heavier concealed armament specified in the accompanying text.<ref name="G2" />
